rationale: Karsin brings deep expertise in distributed systems, database optimization, and analytical SQL engines from his Principal Engineer role at Oracle—areas that could be foundational for scaling data infrastructure in robotics and AI systems. Ben is building in the robotics-AI space and could benefit from technical mentorship on data management challenges that typically emerge as agent systems grow in complexity.
intro_message: Karsin Kamakotti, meet Ben Holfeld — Karsin's background in distributed query optimization and data systems at scale could offer valuable perspective for robotics and AI infrastructure challenges.
